parsed.draft_response:
Hi team—thanks for flagging this as critical. I can confirm we’re treating this as an escalation since the Salesforce sync has been failing in production immediately after your v2.8 upgrade, with repeated auth token refresh errors and reporting blocked for ~40 enterprise customers.

To help engineering investigate quickly (especially with your renewal call tomorrow), could you share the following from the logs:
1) The exact auth token refresh error text(s) including timestamps and any error codes/stack traces.
2) Which sync component/job/service is failing post-upgrade (service name or job identifier).
3) Whether all affected tenants are failing or which specific accounts/tenants are impacted.
4) The last successful sync time and whether there’s a backlog/queue growth (retry behavior is fine too).
5) Any recent Salesforce auth/config changes around the upgrade (connected app/client credentials, OAuth settings, token scopes), if applicable.

As soon as we have the above, we’ll have a human from engineering review the production logs and advise on the next troubleshooting steps.

Reply with the requested log excerpts and job identifiers when you can, and we’ll coordinate from there ahead of your call tomorrow.
promised_actions: Acknowledge escalation to engineering for human review.
Request specific log excerpts and minimal diagnostic details to speed investigation.
Advise on next troubleshooting steps after reviewing the provided production log details.
safety_notes: Avoid claiming root cause, refund, or resolution.
Avoid mentioning SLA/guarantees; only promise escalation and review/troubleshooting steps after receiving requested details.
